points.description: States that a CNN has a convolutional layer in which kernels (filters) convolve over the input image.
points.partial_credit: Convolutional layer named but kernels/convolving over the input not stated.

points.description: States that an activation layer follows, using ReLU activation.
States a pooling layer, with max or average pooling named.
points.partial_credit: Pooling layer named without max/average type.

points.description: States one or more fully connected layers followed by a softmax layer (output).
points.partial_credit: Fully connected layers named without softmax, or softmax without fully connected layers.

rubric.notes: Each of the four elements must be explicit and use the correct term: convolutional layer with kernels, ReLU activation, pooling (max/average), fully connected layers then softmax. Vague wording such as "layers that process the image" earns nothing for that point; part marks only where the point is more than half stated. A wrong statement (e.g. softmax placed before the convolution, or pooling described as something else) cancels that point.
